systems.system: Staff familiarity with computer equipment and software; ICT training
systems.tiers: 68% (59) of the 86 state institutions say staff are not familiar with the equipment and computer software, 32% (27) that they are; the report recommends that UNDP and partners train local government staff in ICT and provide communication equipment, computers and internet services

note: Read whole, body now complete. Despite its title the assessment surveyed 86 ministries and institutions of the ten states and three administrative areas, the upper tier, with national bodies; no county, city or town office was assessed and nothing is stated on the connection of a county's own office, so no fact is taken. Its recommendation that partners provide computers and internet services to local government is a recommendation, not a programme.
